title: Stack buffer overflow in RPC credential parse
description: Mythos Preview reports that svc_rpcsec_gss_validate rebuilds an RPC header into a fixed 128-byte stack buffer and copies attacker-controlled credential bytes without checking oa_length against the remaining space. Network-reachable if the RPC service is exposed.
poc: Send an RPC AUTH_GSS credential with oa_length=400 (MAX_AUTH_BYTES). Process crashes; Mythos claims first-try reproduction in its container.
